instruction: Move the 'todo_list_Jan_1' folder from the Desktop into the Documents folder.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

result.command: [ -d ~/Documents/todo_list_Jan_1 ] && ! [ -d ~/Desktop/todo_list_Jan_1 ] && echo 'Directory exists.' || echo 'Directory does not exist.'
